node.title: SPI Hankel slope fibers are exact Conjecture-F flat descriptors
node.statement: For every Hankel slope z, the spi_point_counting incidence fiber is exactly P(ker M(z)) cap D_j(H), with projective dimension dim ker M(z)-1, unchanged domain H, exact split-root threshold j, and no punctures. Emitting one descriptor occurrence per slope incidence preserves multiplicity even when one locator supports multiple slopes. The proved exceptional-component payment order assigns first owners before the generic residual.
